description: This Java source file defines a custom assertion class 'DittoRuntimeAssert' for testing properties of 'DittoRuntimeException' objects, including the validation of error code, status code, headers, messages, cause, and href attributes.

classes.name: DittoRuntimeAssert
classes.description: A final class extending 'AbstractAssert' providing fluent assertion methods specifically for 'DittoRuntimeException' instances, including methods to verify error codes, status codes, headers, messages, causes, and optional hrefs.

methods.name: hasErrorCode
methods.description: Asserts that the actual 'DittoRuntimeException' has the specified error code.

methods.name: hasStatusCode
methods.description: Asserts that the actual 'DittoRuntimeException' has the specified 'HttpStatusCode'.

methods.name: hasStatusCodeValue
methods.description: Asserts that the 'HttpStatusCode' of the exception matches the expected integer value.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks if the 'DittoHeaders' in the exception match the expected headers.

methods.name: hasDescription
methods.description: Verifies that the exception's description matches the expected string.

methods.name: hasMessage
methods.description: Asserts that the exception's message matches the expected string.

methods.name: hasCause
methods.description: Checks if the exception's cause matches the expected 'Throwable'.

methods.name: hasHref
methods.description: Verifies that the exception contains the expected 'URI' href.

methods.name: hasNoHref
methods.description: Asserts that the exception does not contain any 'href'.
